channel.title: The College Fix - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The College Fix (thecollegefix.com)

item.title: Christendom College cancels classes so students can attend March for Life
item.description: Christendom College helped encourage students to attend the March for Life - and almost all did.

item.title: Liberals love new ‘Starfleet Academy’ series; modern progressive dogma explains why
item.description: Dave Huber critiques the new "Starfleet Academy" series, arguing it’s poorly written and overly focused on identity politics, neglecting Star Trek’s established lore. He suggests the show reflects contemporary progressive ideology, which he believes is detrimental. Huber contrasts the idealized Federation with modern critiques of America, asserting both face unwarranted skepticism in today’s climate.

item.title: U. Arkansas students protest revocation of job offer to pro-transgender law school dean
item.description: University of Arkansas students protested the revocation of law school dean Emily Suski's job offer due to her pro-transgender advocacy. Critics, including Republican lawmakers, prompted the decision, which sparked outrage among students and faculty. Attendees expressed their commitment to free speech and the importance of academic independence in higher education.

item.title: Indiana U. professor sanctioned for creating ‘hostile environment’ for white students
item.description: Reportedly said he would 'rather not associate with white people over the course of the class.'

item.title: Emory University radicals protest ICE: ‘Fundamental rights are under attack’
item.description: Approximately 70 far-left student activists from Emory University protested against ICE, citing recent alleged violence against immigrant communities. Organized by Emory Students for Socialism, speakers emphasized alleged threats to fundamental rights and called for unity against injustice, urging the community to reject actions they view as illegal and oppressive.

item.title: Feminist historian: Shakespeare was really a black Jewish woman
item.description: Irene Coslet's new book claims Shakespeare was actually a black Jewish woman, Emilia Bassano Willoughby, which argues historical narratives erase diverse identities. She suggests Bassano, a talented musician, may have published works under Shakespeare's name to hide her identity. Critics, however, describe the theory as circumstantial and lacking documentary evidence.

item.title: Trump administration abandons court fight to ban DEI in schools and universities
item.description: The administration has focused its efforts on launching specific civil rights investigations into alleged discrimination at high-profile universities to force them to roll back DEI on a case-by-case basis.

item.title: St. John’s University again refuses to approve Turning Point USA
item.description: Catholic St. John's University is refusing to help out a Turning Point USA club. Instead, a school official said the club should just reapply again to the same entity that denied it.

item.title: Morgan State U. restricts student journalists, faculty from direct press access
item.description: A journalism organization and free speech group called out Morgan State University this month in an advocacy letter for restricting the ability of student journalists to gather news directly. item.title: Govt gave $3.3 million science grant to Northwestern for ‘safe space ambassadors’: report
item.description: A report by Sen. Rand Paul highlights a $3.3 million grant to Northwestern University for funding "safe space ambassadors" in the sciences.
